meta.title: allumeriapacks – Community hub for Allumeria language & texture packs
meta.description: Unofficial, fanmade hub for Allumeria: language packs, texture packs & more from the community. Free, browsable, and open to submissions.

banner.text: Fanmade & unofficial — allumeriapacks is not affiliated with the official Allumeria developers.

hero.title: ALLUMERIA PACKS
hero.subtitle: The unofficial hub for Allumeria language and texture packs — collected by fans, browsable for fans.

catalog.title: Available packs
catalog.subtitle: Downloads are hosted externally — allumeriapacks only links out. Same goes for the site owner's own projects.

empty.title: No packs in this category yet
empty.text: Be the first to submit one!

install.title: How to install a pack
install.step1_text: Click "Get download" — the link takes you to that pack's original source.
install.step2_title: Move it to the right folder
install.step2_text: Most language and texture packs belong in your game's resourcepacks/ folder.
install.step3_text: Open the resource pack settings and enable it. Done — enjoy exploring!
install.note: If a pack comes with its own instructions, always follow those instead of this quick guide.

submit.title: Submit your pack
submit.intro: Made a language, texture, or other pack for Allumeria? Fill in the details below — the button opens a pre-filled GitHub issue for us to review and add to the catalog.
submit.license_label: I confirm I own the rights to this content or am authorized to publish it, and that it doesn't violate any applicable law.
submit.note: This opens a new tab with a pre-filled GitHub issue. A GitHub account is only needed to submit it — not to fill out the form.
submit.alt_link: Prefer to fill out the form directly on GitHub?

community.title: Community & Contact
community.text: Found a bug, have a question, or want to help out? Reach out through the channels below.
